summary: Capital One Financial Corporation closed a public offering of €750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 4.326% fixed-to-floating rate senior notes due 2032 and €750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 4.832% fixed-to-floating rate senior notes due 2037, announced via an Item 8.01/9.01 Form 8-K dated September 15, 2026. The notes were sold under a September 9, 2026 underwriting agreement led by Barclays, Deutsche Bank, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley and Capital One Securities, with BNY Mellon, London Branch as paying agent. This is a routine debt capital markets takedown, not a special situation; no equity terms or premiums apply.
